name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I spent four years at Senior Directory, a company focused on healthcare services for seniors, so I've seen how much senior care providers juggle and how little time they have for software that doesn't pull its weight. A workforce platform that helps them staff well and stay compliant is one I'd be glad to help customers get full value from.

Your description of the CSM role, taking the account strategy and turning it into cadence, follow-through, and measurable outcomes, is how I've worked for years. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 reseller partners and kept all but one, mostly by watching utilization and stepping in before an account went quiet. At Wix I managed about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak and launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets. At Level Agency I prepared QBRs built on ROI and LTV analysis, and today at Solenzo I spot services clients aren't using yet and recommend them when they fit the client's goals.

I haven't worked in workforce management software specifically, and I'd come in ready to learn the product and the long-term care operations behind it. I like that this role works alongside a Strategic Account Manager with a path toward that seat. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
